jtbd.jtbd_title: Navigate crisis; protect cadence; advance NCWIT essay scene
jtbd.jtbd_desc: Stabilize workload during external crisis, use micro-blocks, and lock a core NCWIT scene rooted in authentic service.

facts.name: ncwit_core_scene
facts.value: service-oriented moment grounded in lived context

interactions.user_ask: I’m overwhelmed—how do I not lose all momentum?
interactions.jenny_reply: Shrink the loop: two 25‑minute blocks/day. Pick the smallest next proof you can ship—one paragraph, one clip, one email.

interactions.user_ask: How do I reference the crisis without centering it?
interactions.jenny_reply: Keep the focus on what you built for others and the choices you made. One concrete scene beats generalities.

outcomes.name: crisis_micro_cadence
outcomes.details: 2×25m blocks/day + one shippable proof per block

outcomes.name: ncwit_scene_lock
outcomes.details: Chosen core scene anchored in service; outline drafted
